digest.component_or_area: CLI registry and route authority management
propositions: Duplicate route authorities, explicit intercept selection ladders, and 13 literal policy frozensets have been removed from the CLI registry; the router now derives its four policy sets exclusively from _registry.derive_policy_sets()
Every intercept route (21) and audit command carries lazy handler, argv adapter, and init policy metadata, with all dispatch unified through _execute.execute

All 22 commands have exactly one registered runtime-used argparse factory and generated help artifact; both gen_cli_help.py and gen_cli_reference.py pass --check with byte-identical output on second render
Per-command behavior (exit codes, output, stream handling, aliases, capability posture) and init policies are preserved with no unapproved deltas after removal of compatibility exports
Source modules _cli/__init__.py (340 LOC) and _registry.py (754 LOC) remain below 800-line threshold with zero mechanically-split files under 100 lines
Behavioral contracts, execution/degradation paths, and all E2E subprocess tests pass across py3.11/3.12/3.13 on ubuntu+macos after the cutover
